reason: I travel twice a month and always leave my pills at home, so a pre-counted foil sachet I can toss in my bag is exactly my problem. Named lab and a batch report I can check is what gets me past my usual 'is this just marketing' reaction, and the empty-box guarantee makes one box low risk.
objection: A named lab and a QR report sound good, but I would want to actually open the report for my batch and see it matches. Otherwise it is just marketing with a nicer label. Also 2 capsules a day is a bit more than I like to carry.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open or did not match the batch number on the box, I would not buy again.
